method: Read-only production check across every provider: active venues within150m of allfour verified destinations, plus named Christmas Mart,Neuroscape,Hummingbird andVagabond matches within30miles; exact street/clock/title comparison would be required for any candidate match. No existing records matched the location or name probes.
query: select now() observed_at,e.id,e.provider,e.source_key,e.provider_event_id,e.title,e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.end_time_verified,e.venue_name,e.venue_address,e.external_url,extensions.st_y(e.location::extensions.geometry) lat,extensions.st_x(e.location::extensions.geometry) lng from public.external_events e where not e.hidden_for_review and e.status='scheduled' and e.expires_at>now() and e.starts_at<now()+interval '60 days' and (case when e.end_time_verified and e.ends_at>e.starts_at then e.ends_at else e.starts_at+interval '3 hours' end)>now() and (exists(select 1 from (values (39.360186,-74.615697),(39.352284,-74.561652),(39.3706889,-74.5584344),(39.616767,-74.7754785)) v(lat,lng) where extensions.st_dwithin(e.location,extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(v.lng,v.lat),4326)::extensions.geography,150)) or ((lower(e.title) like any(array['%christmas mart%','%neuroscape%','%hummingbird%','%vagabond%'])) and extensions.st_dwithin(e.location,extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(-74.4229,39.3643),4326)::extensions.geography,30*1609.344))) order by e.starts_at,e.title;
